title: Heptabase Updates - Import Podcast Episode, Transcript and Insight, Whiteboard in Right Sidebar, and more!
summary: Heptabase Updates - Import Podcast Episode, Transcript and Insight, Whiteboard in Right Sidebar, and more!
body_markdown:
Dear Heptabase User,


In the past few weeks, we’ve shipped many new features. You can find them in the “Shipped” section of our[roadmap](https://wiki.heptabase.com/roadmap) page, and click on the title to watch a brief introduction video!


---


### Media Card : Import Podcast Episode​


In the latest version, you can search for podcast episodes in Heptabase and add them to your card library as audio cards. After that, you can tag, mention, or transcribe those audio cards!


---


### Media Card : Transcript and Insight​


You can now transcribe your audio or local video files in Heptabase. The processing happens in the background, so you don’t have to wait on that screen.


Once the transcription is done, you can generate insights from the transcript and navigate to the source block with a click.


We’ll soon support YouTube video transcriptions, stay tuned!


*Please note that each user can transcribe up to 5 hours of content for free each month during the beta testing period. We might make adjustments to this in the future.*


---


### Right Sidebar: Use Whiteboard​


We’ve upgraded our right sidebar whiteboard panel! Now you can zoom, pan, and even create or link to cards right there. You can open a card in a new tab and see all the whiteboards it appears on in the right panel.


---


### Heptabase Related Contents​


This week, Greg shared a tutorial on how to use tags in Heptabase. We hope you enjoy it!


Antone shared a quick review of our new podcast and transcript feature. (P.S. We’ve already improved the podcast player in the mobile app. Now you can see a thumbnail of your podcast card and drag the playback progress bar to adjust the segment you're playing.)

---


We hope that these updates will improve your experience on Heptabase and make your learning easier and more enjoyable.


If you have any feedback or suggestions, or you want to share your use cases or contents related to Heptabase, please don't hesitate to chat with us through our[in app support](https://support.heptabase.com/en/articles/10448156-how-can-i-contact-heptabase-support) .


Stay tuned for future updates, and we hope you have a great day!


Best regards,
